アカマツ.el_description: Japanese voice. Native Japanese speaker who speaks only Japanese, with natural standard Japanese pronunciation. Adult voice. a Japanese young man in his early twenties with a clear, light, youthful-sounding voice, a character from a Japanese mythological fantasy card game. Natural yet expressive acting, like a Japanese anime voice actor. Character notes (Japanese): アカマツ・元気・生意気・高い声・気合を込めて・気合の掛け声を重ねる・叫ぶ・叱咤する・悲痛な叫び・2人が同時に同じことを言う

ライカ.el_description: Japanese voice. Native Japanese speaker who speaks only Japanese, with natural standard Japanese pronunciation. An 18-year-old Japanese young woman (an adult), the heroine of a Japanese fantasy adventure anime. Extremely high-pitched voice: a very high, light, clear soprano that stays at the top of her natural speaking range in every line, thin and bright rather than full or deep. Natural, genuine cheerfulness: relaxed, sincere and friendly, never forced, never exaggerated and never shouting; the brightness comes from a soft smile in her voice and natural, conversational intonation. Curious and kind, with casual tomboyish speech. Natural acting like a Japanese anime voice actress playing it straight. Not mature, not low, not husky, not breathy, not theatrical.
previous_descriptions: Japanese voice. Native Japanese speaker who speaks only Japanese, with natural standard Japanese pronunciation. An 18-year-old Japanese young woman (an adult), the cheerful heroine of a Japanese fantasy adventure anime. Very high-pitched voice: a light, sparkling, airy soprano that sits high in the register throughout, bright, clear and youthful, overflowing with energy; bubbly, lively and upbeat, speaking with a bouncy rhythm, a big smile in her voice and big, expressive emotions. Friendly, curious and fearless, always excited about the unknown; casual tomboyish speech. Natural yet expressive acting, like a Japanese anime voice actress. Not mature, not calm, not low, not husky, not breathy.
